test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Go down like a lead balloon

options.text: To be received badly by an audience
Put yourself in a tough position in order to support someone / something

solution:
The correct answer is "**To be received badly by an audience.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• "Idiom" is an expression whose meaning is different from the meanings of the individual words in it.
 
 
• Example: “Spill the beans,” means asking someone to reveal a secret
 
 
 
• **The idiom 'go down like a lead balloon' means to be received poorly or to fail miserably. **(बुरी तरह असफल होना)
 
• The phrase 'lead balloon' refers to something heavy and therefore unable to float or rise.
 
 
• Example: "The comedian's new material went down like a lead balloon with the crowd."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
